beats.headline: He runs the telescope
beats.text: Subject is a juvenile changeling who takes the shape of a boy of about eight, orphaned when the gnomes bombed his village, and now living in Hump Town with a dromedarian named Flint, whose opinions he quotes constantly. He operates the telescope on the roof. He likes to watch the patrol through it to make sure they are okay, and, on Flint's advice, he charges a gold coin for the view.

beats.headline: Crewing as Gangue
beats.text: Aboard Louis's airship, a changeling scout listed as Gangue, suspiciously thin for an adult. Carl works it out halfway to the target: this is Skarn, the child from the fifth floor, who has learned enough about his shapeshifting to hide his age. Carl resolves to have words with Louis and Princess Donut about children going into battle, as soon as they are back, and not before.
